accuracyFlags: Section 03 says a careful solo traveller should budget 'A$80-A$140' a week for groceries; section 07 says 'a hundred to a hundred and seventy dollars a week' for the same traveller. Two different weekly figures on one page.
All prices are community-contributed (Numbeo) June 2026, not ABS or a supermarket source; ranges such as beef A$12-35/kg are too wide to guide a budget.
